data.name: Econew
data.description: Econew is a Brazilian bioenergy company in northern Minas Gerais whose core business is producing hardwood charcoal briquettes from eucalyptus for industrial heating, grilling and steam boilers. In late 2024 it installed a large continuous pyrolysis reactor to add biochar as an adjacent climate-positive product line, and has passed a preliminary Puro.earth assessment toward issuing CORCs. Biochar is a side activity alongside the established briquette business.
